title: "Multiome Regulatory Programs"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Combine motif activity, linked peaks, and gene expression summaries into reusable regulatory program tables.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/multiome_rna_atac_links.qs"
program_file <- "path/to/regulatory_programs.tsv"
output_object <- "path/to/multiome_regulatory_programs.qs"
results_dir <- "results/regulatory_programs"
figures_dir <- "figures/regulatory_programs"
rna_assay <- "RNA"
atac_assay <- "peaks"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
program_column <- "program_name"
gene_column <- "gene_symbol"
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
programs <- readr::read_tsv(program_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(all(c(rna_assay, atac_assay) %in% Assays(object)))
stopifnot(all(c(sample_column, group_column) %in% colnames(object[[]])))
stopifnot(all(c(program_column, gene_column) %in% colnames(programs)))
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
program_summary <- programs |> count(.data[[program_column]], name = "n_genes")
readr::write_tsv(program_summary, file.path(results_dir, "regulatory_program_input_summary.tsv"))
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
DefaultAssay(object) <- rna_assay
program_sets <- split(programs[[gene_column]], programs[[program_column]])
program_sets <- lapply(program_sets, intersect, rownames(object[[rna_assay]]))
program_sets <- program_sets[lengths(program_sets) > 0]
object <- AddModuleScore(object, features = program_sets, assay = rna_assay, name = "regulatory_program_")
program_score_cols <- tail(colnames(object[[]]), length(program_sets))
names(program_score_cols) <- names(program_sets)
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
score_tbl <- object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") |> select(cell_id, all_of(program_score_cols), all_of(c(sample_column, group_column)))
readr::write_tsv(score_tbl, file.path(results_dir, "regulatory_program_scores.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "regulatory_program_scores.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)
print(VlnPlot(object, features = program_score_cols, group.by = group_column, pt.size = 0))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
object@misc$regulatory_programs <- list(program_file = program_file, score_columns = program_score_cols)
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(program_summary, file.path(results_dir, "regulatory_program_gene_counts.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-multiome-04-regulatory-programs-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, programs_scored = length(program_score_cols))
```
